scope: Reporting of already audited loops-on scalar correlations; no raw-array analysis or inference

definitions.score: selection_score__{rule}_uncapped_loops1; previous observed base or current observed base, as named
definitions.residual: sum over 2 coordinates of normalized_residual__base_uncapped_loops1 squared
definitions.benefit: base normalized vector squared error minus own selected-graph normalized vector squared error; signed
definitions.normalization: position prediction residual divided coordinatewise by saved acceleration_std; decoder-equivalent normalized acceleration error
definitions.correlation: within-frame particle Spearman using average ranks, no mask; dimensionless
definitions.aggregation: equal frame means within trajectory, equal trajectory means within seed, then mean and sample SD of exactly three seeds
definitions.undefined: fewer than two particles or constant rank vector gives null; required null propagates, no available-case averaging
definitions.graph: self-loops on, uncapped selected graph globally ordered; native cap inactive on measured histories; distinct from native prefix-plus-suffix autonomous evaluator
definitions.interpretation: whole selected graph action, not marginal edge utility; not a calibration guarantee, causal concentration result or independent confirmation

checks: independent scalar audit binds original summary
compact groups equal original summary exactly
